title: Report / export request

object_ids.description: server-authorized nonempty IDs;no all-tenants wildcard. Scope is immutable in job

period_start.description: UTC instant;before end;within retention. User timezone converted explicitly

period_end.description: after start;not future for actual report. End-exclusive interval documented

book.description: supported for caller and report;business never investment. Do not merge origins

currency.description: supported conversion policy or show separate currencies. Reference rate basis shown

format.description: server supports generation;PDF only after renderer implemented. No formula injection in CSV

include_sensitive.description: only explicitly permitted by current scope. Secrets always excluded

description: Ready-input schema plus server business validation. Draft input uses identical property types but permits missing required fields; missingness must be displayed. Identity/password forms never saved as drafts.
